开始动手了！美国开始堵截东南亚 AI 算力转口通道。

11 月 13 日，马来西亚与新加坡几乎同步采取行动，东南亚正在成为美国芯片出口管制的新监管前线。

- 马来西亚启动调查： 投资、贸易及工业部联合海关，核查数据中心租户 Speedmatrix 自带服务器和 AI 芯片入驻机房，是否涉及违规转出口。

- 新加坡起诉第五名嫌疑人： 涉及向马来西亚转口、内含英伟达高端芯片服务器的贸易欺诈案，已有第五名涉案人员被起诉。

- 美国国会加大施压： 商务部长卢特尼克收到 12 月 10 日出席参议院听证会的邀请，黄仁勋则被邀请于 12 月 3 日出席。

- OpenAI 转向支持更严格管制： 据彭博社报道，OpenAI 已向国会表达支持进一步限制中国获取先进 AI 芯片及半导体制造设备的立场。相关提案还涉及芯片追踪和海外 GPU 远程访问。

与此同时，中芯国际 2026 年第三季度中国区营收占比升至 90.8%，产能利用率达到 97.3%，本土晶圆代工需求持续增长。

这背后的变化值得警惕：

过去，美国主要通过出口许可证控制先进芯片流向；现在，监管范围正在向第三国转口、数据中心部署，甚至海外 GPU 算力租赁延伸。这意味着，即使芯片没有进入中国境内，中国企业通过新加坡、马来西亚等地租用海外 GPU，也可能面临更严格的审查。

黄仁勋过去一直试图在美国国家安全政策与英伟达全球商业利益之间寻找平衡。如今，越来越多 AI 企业开始支持收紧出口限制，华盛顿对先进算力的监管也正在从芯片贸易延伸至算力使用。

美国要控制的可能不再只是显卡卖给谁，而是谁有权使用这些显卡。对于中国 AI 产业而言，国产 GPU、国产云计算和本土算力基础设施的替代价值，正在进一步上升。

注：马来西亚目前仍处于调查阶段；卢特尼克收到的是听证会邀请，并非已确认出席；相关出口限制法案也尚未全部通过。

DOJ SEEKS FORFEITURE OF $65K USDC FROZEN BY CIRCLE

The U.S. Attorney's Office for the Northern District of Ohio moved to forfeit approximately $65K in $USDC recovered from a nearly $200K scam targeting an Eastlake resident's retirement savings.

A fake financial adviser used remote laptop access to execute roughly 60 Coinbase transfers, blocking withdrawals with a fabricated $860K balance and IRS tax freeze.

FBI Cleveland traced the $USDC on Ethereum, and Circle blocklisted the wallet under a May 20, 2026 warrant to return the funds to the victim.

Nvidia's $NVDA board has approached Arm Holdings CEO Rene Haas as one of several candidates to replace Jensen Huang, though an offer or acceptance is not guaranteed, per @FinancialTimes.

Haas spent seven years at Nvidia before joining Arm in 2013 and leading its 2023 Nasdaq listing, while Nvidia CFO Colette Kress serves as interim CEO.

Huang resigned Thursday following extramarital affair revelations, including one involving a suspected Chinese spy, leaving Nvidia shares down over 3% and Arm down more than 5%, per Reuters.

tweets.text: just incredible to see the reviews coming in for The Everything Code... keep em coming, I read every single one https://t.co/EKKiV9DoR3

A patch of lily pads doubles in size every day.

If they take 30 days to cover the pond, then on day 29 the pond is only half covered. On day 28, a quarter. On day 25, it’s still 97% empty.

For three and a half weeks, all you can see is a small green patch in the corner of a big pond.

Then, in the final five days, they cover everything. Not because anything changed. The pads were doubling the whole time... it’s just that doubling something tiny looks like nothing, and doubling something big looks like an explosion.

Our brains don’t work that way. We see a small patch and assume it'll stay small. That’s why things like the internet, smartphones and bitcoin looked like toys for years and then seemed to take over out of nowhere.

I wrote about this pond in The Everything Code because it’s the simplest way to explain what’s happening right now. AI and robotics are on that same curve as we speak.... but most people will wait until the pond is obviously covered before they act.

By then, it’s day 30. And the game is already over.

How do changes to monetary expansion (ρ) and treasury share (τ) affect staking rewards, pool viability and the pace of reserve depletion? And what role could transaction fees and block capacity play in the longer term?

SPOs and Delegators are especially encouraged to join, share their perspectives, and challenge the researchers' assumptions and findings. The discussion is an opportunity to question the scenarios presented, bring different experiences to the table and help identify areas for further research.
